title: Got a Raise? Do This Before You Spend It
description: Save half of a $5,000 raise and you set aside $2,500 a year. Over 10 years that is $25,000, or about $34,500 if invested at a hypothetical 7% return. Educational only, not financial advice. #savingmoney #personalfinance #shorts

title: He Gave Away His $3 Billion Company
description: In 2022, Patagonia founder Yvon Chouinard and his family transferred their ownership of the company, valued at about $3 billion, to a trust and a nonprofit focused on fighting climate change. #patagonia #entrepreneur #shorts
